# A write lands while the offload callback runs, over part of what it was
# offered: the report marks only the offered version, so the new bytes stay
# dirty and a release of the reported extent is refused until they are
# offloaded too.
write s=1 f=3 len=32 b=48
offload s=1 f=3 off=8 len=8 b=120 pick=1
release s=1 f=3
offload s=1 f=3
release s=1 f=3
reopen
